params.caption: 🎮 Why Capcom's modern Resident Evil remakes skipped the first game Capcom passed over the original Resident Evil when it started its modern remake series, worried a remake of the first game might not resonate with players. According to the team, the opening of Resident Evil 2 essentially works as the starting point for the story anyway. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 01:01 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ #ResidentEvil #Capcom #GamingNews
